concerns.text: Task T005 uses `years_training` as the primary skill proxy in the regression (`PC_score ~ years_training + age + fd + scanner_site + session_order`). Constitution Principle VII requires skill ratings to be derived from expert blind ratings or pre‑study assessments; neither `years_training` nor task condition satisfies this, so the task violates the constitutional statistical‑rigor requirement.

Success Criterion SC‑004 (pipeline must complete ≤ 6 h, ≤ 7 GB RAM on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner) has no associated verification step in any task. The checklist lacks a task that measures or asserts runtime or memory usage, resulting in a dropped acceptance criterion.
